title: New fold-check subcommand has zero automated coverage — its FAIL path (the point of the gate) is never exercised and it is wired into no CI gate
evidence: ci-local.sh GATES list (lines 52-62) ends at: "Input parity (T1 across inputs — mouse == touch == controller + CLI arg-validation leg)|tools/harness.sh input-parity && [ -x ./bin/harness ] && ! ./bin/harness input-parity bogus >/dev/null 2>&1" — no fold-check entry (grep 'fold-check' tools/ci-local.sh → no match). fold_check.odin prints but never reads the manifest it claims to cross-check: fmt.printfln("fold-check: new tick-1        %016x  (the blessed manifest must match)", new_tick1); the only automated-style evidence is the one-shot run quoted in PR prose.
detail: r3 N11's tool exists but nothing pins it: exit-1 FAIL detection, exit-2 arg/parse errors, and the manifest cross-check claim are untested. A bug making it always-PASS would go unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Add a ci-local leg: `./bin/harness fold-check 66c4324a06058860 ab1fb0d04a90026c` (expect 0) plus a bogus prev-tick1 (expect 1) — mirroring the input-parity bogus-arg pattern in gate 10.

title: r3-B1 double-free fix and N6 leak fix have no standing automated guard — the in-suite allocator masks exactly this defect class
detail: The ownership fix is sound by inspection (verified: catalogs_destroy deletes eras[i].entries once; trimmed buffer allocated with context.allocator transfers cleanly), but nothing prevents reintroduction — r3's exact failure mode.
recommended_fix: Add a leak-fails gate for demand_test (or a standalone allocator-abort repro in tools/) so a reintroduced double-free or leak in this test fails CI instead of relying on review.

title: role_from_name's new string→enum mappings have no direct pin — the NT_VALID load baseline only proves non-None, not which role
evidence: role_from_name: `case "small_biz":   return .Small_Biz` / `case "campus":      return .Campus`. The loader's only discrimination is `if nt.kind == .Terminal && nt.terminal_role == .None { return {"node_types.json", nt.id, "terminal without a role"} }` (catalog.odin:379) — so NT_VALID loading clean pins only that the strings are KNOWN. grep for Small_Biz/Campus in catalog_test.odin: only the NT_VALID JSON strings; no assertion of parsed role values; grep role_from_name in *_test.odin: no direct test.
detail: A swapped mapping (small_biz→.Campus) would load clean and stay self-consistent across demand/node parsing; only golden-hash drift would surface it indirectly. PR's 'pinned by the extended NT_VALID load baseline' overstates the pin.
recommended_fix: One-line unit pin in check_ok: node_type_index(cat, "campus") → expect terminal_role == .Campus (and small_biz == .Small_Biz) after catalogs_load.

title: New sprite-less fallback geometry for Small_Biz/Campus (flat-roof blocks, window grid, tower) is untested — dead code in every automated gate
evidence: draw_building gates on `if v.sprites.ok {` (view.odin:505); the new branch runs only without the sheet: "// 5.11 fallback: flat-roof blocks (office / campus) — a DISTINCT shape / // from the peaked-roof house (E9.1 even on the primitive path)." palcheck (the only gate that could render it) aborts before any check when sprites fail: `if !rnd.sprites_load(&view.sprites) { fmt.eprintln("palcheck: sprite sheet failed to load — aborting"); return 2 }` (palcheck.odin:128-130).
detail: The PR's E9.1 claim 'distinct primitive shapes ... even without the sheet' has no test: the ~40 new geometry lines (window grid, campus tower) are unreachable in all 10 CI gates.
recommended_fix: Either pin one fallback-render frame in palcheck (construct a View with sprites.ok=false over the terminal_types scene) or explicitly descope the fallback as untested defensive code in the PR body.

title: W9 campus-half floor hardcodes literal 10 while EXPECTED is derived — a surge-multiplier/campus-volume re-tune desyncs the two floors
evidence: testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100, "the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", ...) — while the total derives: stream_entries += e.volume ... EXPECTED := i64(stream_entries) * i64(surge.multiplier) * i64(WINDOW), annotated "a future re-tune of the surge timing, the multiplier, or the streaming entry count cannot silently drift this pin".
detail: 10 = campus volume 1 × multiplier 10, consistent today (campus floor = MIN_LAND/2 exactly), but the N5 rationale doesn't cover it: a multiplier re-tune leaves this floor stale — loudly wrong, still a re-tune trap.
recommended_fix: Derive the campus floor from the campus entry: sum volumes where source_role == .Campus, × surge.multiplier × WINDOW × 95/100 (0 when absent, guarded by campuses >= 1).

title: usage() message omits the new fold-check verb — mis-invocation prints a usage list that doesn't mention it
evidence: fmt.eprintln("usage: harness run|save [demo...] [--stats-out <path>] | replay <demo> <log.bin> | drift-check | preview-check | stats-check <demo> | input-parity [save] | palcheck | map-preview <seed> [out.png]") — no fold-check, though main.odin:140 dispatches `if verb == "fold-check" { if len(rest) != 2 { usage() } ...` and the header comment (line 22-24) documents it.
detail: A wrong-arg fold-check call exits 2 with a usage string that hides the verb's own argument format — the only discoverability is the source comment.
recommended_fix: Append '| fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>' to the usage() line in the same edit that added the verb.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: Traceability of the PR's non-test behavior changes: Terminal_Role enum append FULL (goldens byte-identity + fold proof + palcheck pins); node_types/demand.json entries FULL (loader fail-fast + harness T1/T2 on real files); growth roster/era gating FULL (era 1/2/4-type pins + e31 validity + W9 growth_born>=1, threshold verified: 2+8+6+4=20 fixture nodes, ids monotonic from 0); accumulator profiles FULL (333/1000, 2500/3000 unit pins); inertness FULL (durable pin + negative controls + spawn control); W9 re-pin FULL (derived window/ask, per-role floors, type-relative burst); sprite index/footprint FULL (palcheck unit pins 4/9/10/0 + pixel floors 176/1100); role_from_name PARTIAL; fallback primitives NONE; fold-check verb NONE automated. Suite run: 194/194 green.
detail: P0 100%, P1 ~100% (every critical sim/golden path pinned). Overall ≈75-85%: two non-critical new surfaces (fold-check tool, sprite-less fallback) plus the memory-safety fixes carry zero standing automated coverage — below the PASS bar despite excellent core coverage.
recommended_fix: Add the fold-check PASS+FAIL legs to ci-local, a direct role_from_name pin, a fallback-path or explicit-descoping decision, and a leak-fails leg for demand_test — that clears every residual gap to PASS.
